NEW_COUNTERPARTIES.label: first payment between the two accounts

ESTABLISHED_COUNTERPARTIES.label: accounts that paid each other 3+ times before

PASS_THROUGH.label: sender paid out 80%+ of what it received that day

FAST_ONWARD_TRANSFER.label: receiver paid out 80%+ of what it received that day

DORMANT_THEN_ACTIVE.label: sender had no earlier activity, then 3+ payments in a day

EQUAL_SPLITS.label: sender's payments that day were near-identical amounts

CONVERGENCE.label: money reached one receiver through 2+ middle accounts

ROUND_TRIP.label: money went back to the sender the same day

CYCLE.label: money went back to the sender the same day
